data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_vX9UZ","src":"https://bbx-pic.gtimg.com/bbx/pictures/2026/458_20260828145257_027918.gif","caption":"心选卡形态","naturalWidth":800,"naturalHeight":1739,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"心选卡形态支持品牌以主推商品或品牌 TVC 剧情设置双组件选项，吸引用户参与互动；首次支持双氛围动效配置，用户点击后即可触发沉浸式氛围动效。从选择、动效惊喜到最终落地转化一气呵成，引导用户在种草后丝滑进入落地页，完成完整的互动转化链路。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_T4eS9","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]}]}]}
